source: AT&T usage details (cellular calls, SMS/MMS, mobile data) + the hand-kept call log
caveats: iMessage, FaceTime, WhatsApp and Wi-Fi data never reach AT&T, so they are not here.
AT&T rounds every call up to the next whole minute.

filters.talk: Talk time counts calls to real people longer than 1 minute.
filters.spam: Spam = numbers that only ever called you and never got a call or text back.
